keySentence: A brave child said what no one else dared.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The child was honest. Truth is important. Be brave like the child. A brave child said what no one else dared.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The emperor learned a big lesson about honesty that day. All the adults were too scared to speak the truth. A brave child said what no one else dared to say. It takes courage to be honest when everyone is lying. The child showed that truth is more important than fear. From that day on, the emperor became a wiser ruler.
facts.Word cards: child = 아이 / truth = 진실 / nothing = 아무것도 없는 / laughed = 웃었다 / honest = 정직한
